rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1998).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Pocock's Nurseries/Pocock's Roses in 2005 as 'Honeybun'.
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 2006 as 'Ninetta'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, ages to salmon-orange . . Mild fragrance. up to 55 petals. Average diameter 1.5". Small, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, rosette bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Glossy foliage.

Height: 1' to 16" (30 to 40cm).
